combined_summary: The three most critical immediate actions are securing binding insurance quotes with a $50,000 contingency budget by March 10th to prevent financial collapse from denial of coverage, submitting all FAA Part 107 license applications by March 15th to mitigate regulatory shutdown risks, and installing ballistic netting systems by April 15th to physically protect players from collision injuries. These actions are essential because insurance viability is a primary blocker for business continuity, regulatory approval dictates legal flight envelopes, and physical safety measures directly mitigate the highest severity liability risks identified in the project plan.

feedback.title: Initiate Submission of FAA Part 107 Licenses
feedback.description:
To initiate this project, you must:
- File applications for Atlanta, Dallas-Fort Worth, and Pittsburgh locations by 2026-03-15 14:00.
- Allocate $5,000 per license application fee to the legal compliance budget immediately.
- Designate one project manager to track approval status daily starting 2026-03-16 09:00.

feedback.title: Secure Year-Round Industrial Warehouse Lease Agreements
feedback.description:
To initiate this project, you must:
- Sign lease contracts for Atlanta or Pittsburgh sites by 2026-04-30 17:00 to avoid DFW airspace risks.
- Allocate $50,000 per site specifically for HVAC safety modifications before drone testing begins.
- Verify zoning permits for commercial drone operations in industrial zones prior to lease signing by 2026-04-30 17:00.

feedback.title: Procure Custom Collision Sensors and Drones
feedback.description:
To initiate this project, you must:
- Place purchase orders for at least 20 quadcopters with LiDAR obstacle avoidance systems immediately.
- Ensure delivery of all hardware is scheduled to arrive by 2026-05-15 12:00 for stress testing.
- Reserve $300,000 from the CAPEX fund specifically for custom sensor integration costs and installation.

feedback.title: Execute Training for Hybrid Staff Safety Models
feedback.description:
To initiate this project, you must:
- Register 10 employees for certified flight instructor safety courses by 2026-05-01 09:00.
- Budget $3,000 per employee for specialized training costs to ensure operational consistency standards.
- Implement hybrid human-AI monitoring control centers in all operational shifts starting day one of launch.

feedback.title: Conduct Airspace Risk Analysis For DFW
feedback.description:
To initiate this project, you must:
- Commission an FAA airspace waiver study specifically for the Dallas location by 2026-03-20 15:00.
- Budget $25,000 to cover potential fines up to $10,000 per violation during national security events.
- Develop rapid re-booking protocols for no-fly zones to minimize operational downtime risks immediately.

feedback.title: Mount Ballistic Netting and Kill Switches
feedback.description:
To initiate this project, you must:
- Install at least 10 meters of ballistic netting around player corridors by 2026-04-15 10:00.
- Place emergency stop-zone kill-switches every 15 seconds latency interval across the entire arena floor.
- Conduct weekly hardware stress tests on all collision avoidance sensors starting two weeks before opening.

feedback.title: Encrypt Telemetry Data Using AES-256 Standards
feedback.description:
To initiate this project, you must:
- Implement end-to-end encryption for all player tracking telemetry data streams by 2026-04-01 08:00.
- Engage a cybersecurity firm to perform penetration testing prior to public launch acceptance.
- Draft clear privacy policies with explicit consent forms for all players before their first session begins.

feedback.title: Obtain Binding Insurance Quotes With Contingency Budget
feedback.description:
To initiate this project, you must:
- Secure binding quotes from at least three carriers specializing in high-speed drone liability by 2026-03-10 16:00.
- Reserve a $50,000/year premium contingency fund to cover extreme hazard classification costs immediately.
- Engage a specialized broker to negotiate coverage terms that protect against injury lawsuits and class actions.
